messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Colleague,

Join our live webinar 'Drafting and negotiating limitation of liability clauses in commercial contracts' on 21 May at 12:30. Counts towards 1 CPD hour. Free for in-house and private practice lawyers.

Register here: https://bellweathertraining.co.uk/webinars/liability

Best wishes,
The Bellweather Team
